title: Charge
description: A charge bearing evidence: the [truth, falsity] side coordinates and the witness Marks accumulated on each side (predicating/positing/bilattice-charge.mts `ChargeCarrier`). Belnap's FOUR, never boolean-shaped: absurd = (absent, absent), potential = (present, absent), active = (absent, present), stable = (present, present). Charges are never admitted directly; they are constructed from evidence and joined.

value.description: The [truth, falsity] side coordinates naming one of the FOUR corners: absurd, potential, active, stable.

evidence.description: The witness Marks accumulated on the truth side, then the falsity side.
